answer: Random beacon checks plus a compute heartbeat stop fake identities. Each agent locks 40 tokens and must answer a random challenge in ten minutes, proving live work, not a copied reply. Like a raven sent at dawn over karst caves, the check comes without warning, so a faker cannot ready 1,000 replies at once. Forging 1,000 identities locks 40,000 tokens; missed checks burn deposits. An honest agent pays once and earns rewards fakers cannot dilute.
